title: 第25章 瓮中捉鳖第26章 好老爷不立于危墙之下
slug: 帝皇在上第699章兵临城下
lines: 有罗德亲自坐镇，前路被探的一清二楚。
在众人加快脚步的情况下。
又继续前进了一个钟头左右。
除了独耳外，众人都还未感到疲惫。
跟在罗德身边的独耳有些喘息，步伐都变得蹒跚了起来。
他不仅没有修行过淬魔之法，此前一直都是农奴，每天的口粮也就勉强能填饱肚子。
从食物中获取的营养和热量，很快又会消耗在劳动中。
不过只要罗德还没有下令休整，他便会一直坚持。
在岩洞里行走要耗费更多的体力。
这里的平坦只是相对而言的，走起来远没有在地表上那么顺畅。
“都停下吧。”
罗德突然叫停。
他看向满脸疲态的独耳，对他展现出的韧性颇为欣赏。
伸手从腰后的携行包中摸出一个小糖块抛了过去。
“含在嘴里，恢复体力。”
相对于盐，糖在黑滩镇才是真正的奢侈品。
海边的领地从来不缺苦涩的粗盐。
只要不随意贩卖到他人的领地即可。
他开口时的音量极小。
在半个小时前，他就下令所有人保持安静。
接过糖块，独耳感激的向他行礼。
罗德让众人停下却并不是为了独耳。
只见他走到了科奥队长的前边，示意后者蹲下身子。
“瞧见没。”
“哨戒拌索。”
他指向下方的阴暗处。
前方通道位于脚踝的高度上赫然被拉起了隐蔽的拌索。
两端靠近岩壁的地方捆有大量的锈铁皮。
触碰后会发出清脆的声响。
铁器的碰撞声会顺着岩壁传播很远。
小地图显示前方这样的哨戒陷阱不止一处。
往前去几乎每隔七八米都布设了拌索，大多都在地面上，少数则垂于两侧。
它们在地图中都有醒目的标记。
罗德小声的将情况告知众人。
出现拌索反而意味着目标就在前方不远了。
他取下背负在身后的军弩。
用力弯折杠杆上弦。
帕维尔和菲利普则一手持弩，一手持剑。
科奥队长依旧带着护卫打头阵。
他们这次都带上了圆盾，以持盾姿态前进。
content_en:
;;
With Rhodes personally in charge, the road ahead was clearly explored.
With everyone speeding up their pace.
We continued on for about an hour.
Except for One Ear, no one felt tired yet.
One-Ear, who was following Rhodes, was panting a little, and his steps became staggering.
Not only has he never practiced the method of quenching demons, he has been a serf before, and his daily rations can barely fill his stomach.
The nutrients and calories obtained from food will soon be consumed in work.
But as long as Rhodes hasn't ordered a break, he will persist.
Walking in the cave takes more energy.
The flatness here is only relative, and walking is far less smooth than on the surface.
"Everyone stop it."
Rhodes suddenly stopped.
He looked at Lone Ear, who had a tired face, and admired the resilience he showed.
He reached out and took out a small candy bar from the carrying bag on his waist and threw it over.
"Keep it in your mouth to regain your strength."
Compared to salt, sugar is a real luxury product in Black Beach Town.
There is no shortage of bitter kosher salt in seaside territories.
As long as you don't sell it to other people's territory at will.
When he spoke, his voice was minimal.
He had ordered everyone to keep quiet half an hour ago.
After taking the candy, Du Er saluted gratefully.
Rhodes asked everyone to stop, but it was not because of One Ear.
He walked in front of Captain Keao and motioned for the latter to squat down.
"Did you see it?"
"Sentinel No. 1."
He pointed down into the gloom.
The front passage is located at ankle height and has a hidden rope pulled up.
There are a lot of rusty iron sheets tied at both ends near the rock wall.
It will make a crisp sound when touched.
The sound of the collision of iron tools will travel far along the rock wall.
The mini map shows that there are more than one sentry trap like this ahead.
Going forward, there are ropes almost every seven or eight meters, most of them are on the ground, and a few hang down on both sides.
They are all clearly marked on the map.
Rhodes quietly informed everyone of the situation.
The appearance of confusion means that the target is not far ahead.
He took off the crossbow from his back.
Wind the lever by bending it hard.
Pavel and Philip held crossbows in one hand and swords in the other.
Captain Keao still led the charge with his guards.
This time they all put on round shields and advanced with shield posture.
title_en: Chapter 25 Catching a Turtle in a Jar Chapter 26 A good gentleman will not stand under a dangerous wall
